briefs: Indonesia: candy factory fire kills 3, 36 missing in Cikande — search paused Sunday as ruins smoulder.
West Bank: settlers torch 12 vehicles in four villages; opposition leader Eisenkot calls it ‘terrorism’.
Denmark expelled Russia’s defence attache Friday over an alleged plot to kill rapper Kyivstoner.
NATO council meets in Brussels on Monday after Russian missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
FBI probes a reported hack of its national crime database, the NCIC.
UK and EU strike a major post-Brexit deal; EU and Indonesia sign a landmark trade pact.

hero.deck: EU and island nations reject a draft with no mention of fossil fuels; the longest climate summit on record ends Sunday with no overarching agreement. President Kurum: “These decisions have not been adopted.”
hero.headline: COP31 COLLAPSES: NO DEAL

tiles.body: Sea drones hit the corvette Merkury at dawn; images show it mostly sunk. The Ascalon was hit hours later.
tiles.headline: Russian warship sunk by sea drones

tiles.body: A drone collapsed a five-storey block overnight: 2 killed, 4 hurt, ~12 missing; a boy, 7, was pulled alive after 14 hours.
tiles.headline: Drone flattens apartment block

tiles.body: Saturday’s missiles and drones hit a civilian site on Sitra Island, setting it ablaze; two tankers were struck in Hormuz.
tiles.headline: Iran strike wounds two in Bahrain

tiles.body: Special forces seized cartel boss Fausto Isidro Meza Flores on Saturday in a raid that left 11 dead, including four soldiers.
tiles.headline: ‘El Chapo Isidro’ captured

tiles.body: After an eight-year journey, the ESA–JAXA craft fired its thrusters Saturday and entered orbit around Mercury.
tiles.headline: BepiColombo reaches Mercury

wide.body: From a two-year low near $55,100 on Saturday, Bitcoin bounced about 12% to a Sunday high of $61,568 — still down more than 20% in November.
wide.headline: Bitcoin tops $61,000 in weekend rebound
